CoordinateSystem: Unity world space, metres. Map up = north = +Z, right = east = +X. Pixel coordinates from the image's top-left corner.
FlatOpenGroundDefinition: slope <= 12 deg, >= 2 m above sea level, no terrain tree in the surrounding 3x3 block of 10 m cells, >= 15 m from existing structure footprints. Geometric only; not a site recommendation.
Notes: No road or path objects; trails exist only if painted into the terrain texture.
No river or lake objects. Only the ocean plane at sea level.
No enclosed basins below sea level (no inland water).
